SPIDER RIDDLE #1 · Part 1/2 🧩 Dono haare. Kyun?
2 traders, dono $1000 se start. Dono ne 10 trades liye: 5 jeete, 5 haare, RR 1:1, baari-baari. Trader A har trade 10% risk, Trader B 2%. Same win rate, same RR — phir bhi 10 trades ke baad dono ka balance $1000 se kam. Kaun kam haara, A ya B? Aur dono haare kyun?
Jawab comment me likho 👇 Kal 9 AM jawab reel (Part 2/2) + pinned comment me.
